description.en: Native macOS Notification Center alerts for DeepSeek Harness when the agent asks for your choice, a task completes, or a task fails. Notifications are posted by the app's own renderer, so they carry the DeepSeek Harness name and icon; clicking a notification opens the corresponding session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 macOS 通知中心提醒：智能体需要你做出选择、任务完成或任务失败时弹出通知。通知由应用自身渲染进程发出，显示 DeepSeek Harness 的名称与图标；点击通知可直接跳回对应会话。
